subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The manager, decided at last to __bring the stenographer to book__ for her illegal money transactions after trying to ignore it several times.

options.text: bring her for a detailed investigation
place her in a safe supportive position
make her accountable for her conduct

solution: The correct answer is **Option 4)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"bring to book"** means to hold someone accountable for their actions or to reprimand them officially. (किसी को जिम्मेदार ठहराना) • **Example: **The authorities decided** to bring** the corrupt officials to** book.** • **"Make her accountable for her conduct"** refers to the act of ensuring someone takes responsibility for their actions or behavior. (उसे उसके आचरण के लिए जिम्मेदार ठहराना) • **Example: **The company made the employee **accountable for her misconduct** by initiating a disciplinary action. Hence, we can infer that the correct substitution for the given segment is **'make her accountable for her conduct'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: bring her for a detailed investigation** (उसे विस्तृत जांच के लिए लाना): This means to bring someone in for a thorough examination or inquiry. • **Example:** The police** brought the suspect for a detailed investigation.** • **Option 2: take her into great confidence** (उसे बड़ी आत्मविश्वास में लेना): This means to trust someone deeply or to confide in someone. • **Example: **The manager **took her into great confidence** and shared the company's future plans. • **Option 3: place her in a safe supportive position** (उसे एक सुरक्षित सहायक स्थिति में रखना): This means to ensure someone is in a secure and supportive environment. • **Example:** The organization **placed her in a safe supportive position** after the incident. 43:Tcf2, The correct answer is **Option 2)**
